title: Encouraging Private Sector Companies to Aim for BCA Green Mark for Super Low Energy Buildings Certification
what_it_is: Encouraging Private Sector Companies to Aim for BCA Green Mark for Super Low Energy Buildings Certification

sections.label: Super Low Energy building adoption
sections.summary: BCA reports 18 buildings with Super Low Energy certification and describes a Technology Roadmap, funding and a Smart Hub to drive adoption.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As of December 2019, 18 buildings have achieved the BCA Green Mark for Super Low Energy certification.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To drive the adoption of Super Low Energy buildings, BCA worked with the industry and academia to develop a Technology Roadmap, which comprises 60 strategies and technologies that building owners can adopt to increase energy efficiency.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We have also enhanced the Green Buildings Innovation Cluster programme with a $20 million top-up last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The programme aims to accelerate the adoption of Super Low Energy buildings through funding the research, development and prototyping of energy-efficient building solutions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In addition, BCA has established the Super Low Energy Building Smart Hub to facilitate the exchange of knowledge on energy-efficient technologies amongst industry stakeholders.

sections.label: NUS hybrid cooling system
sections.summary: The NUS School of Design and Environment Building 4 uses a hybrid cooling system with ceiling fans that is 46% more efficient than conventional cooling.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The other example is the National University of Singapore School of Design and Environment Building 4 which uses a hybrid cooling system that augments the cool air supply with ceiling fans, making it 46% more efficient than a conventional cooling system.

sections.label: Technologies already public
sections.summary: The technologies are already in use and therefore already public.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The fact that the technologies are already in use, I think it is already public.
